rows.sourceTitle: 特賜興禪大燈國師參詳語要

Override.AttributionNote: Essentials of the Detailed Investigations of Imperially Honored Daitō Kokushi (特賜興禪大燈國師參詳語要), in its section on matters in Xuedou's record. The line explicitly introduces the verse with ‘therefore Master Changsha said’ (所以長沙和尚道); Changsha Jingcen is the exact quoted speaker saying that even entry is not yet genuine and that one must step forward from atop the hundred-foot pole. The section heading names the record being investigated, not Xuedou Chongxian as speaker of Changsha's verse.
